name: SDD Plan Template (AI-Driven Task Structure)
description: Implementation plan template focused on HOW to implement (not WHAT to implement)

summary.title: Summary
summary.instruction: Extract from feature spec: primary requirement + technical approach. Focus on business value and user outcomes.

technicalContext.title: Technical Context
technicalContext.instruction: Extract key implementation decisions from specification. Focus on HOW to implement, not WHAT to implement. Include only essential technical context for implementation approach.

projectStructure.title: Project Structure
projectStructure.instruction: 🚨 MANDATORY PROJECT STRUCTURE: Define the EXACT folder structure that MUST be followed during implementation. Include specific directory names, file naming conventions, and organizational rules. This structure will be strictly enforced during implementation - NO DEVIATIONS ALLOWED. Follow SDD path conventions with lib/[feature-name]/, contracts/, tests/ structure.
projectStructure.template:
src/
├── lib/[feature-name]/          # Library implementation
│   ├── models/                  # Data models
│   ├── services/                # Business logic
│   └── cli.(ts|py|rs|go)        # Command interface
├── contracts/                   # API specifications
└── tests/
    ├── contract/                # Contract tests
    ├── integration/             # Integration tests
    └── unit/                    # Unit tests
projectStructure.enforcement: This project structure is MANDATORY and must be followed exactly during implementation. Any deviation will result in implementation failure.

implementationPhases.title: Implementation Phases (AI-Driven Task Structure with Mandatory Verification)
implementationPhases.taskApproach: Atomic tasks with explicit action verbs (EXECUTE, RUN, COMPILE, SHOW, CONFIRM) and mandatory proof requirements. RED-GREEN-REFACTOR-SMOKE pattern enforced.
implementationPhases.verificationFramework: Every task requires proof of execution (terminal output, file counts, test results). Forbidden states prevent AI from gaming the system.
implementationPhases.timeoutConfiguration: All test executions include timeouts to prevent AI hanging: Unit tests (60s), Integration tests (90s), Full test suite (120s), Build process (60s), Startup process (30s). Timeout messages indicate when processes exceed limits.
implementationPhases.aiDrivenGeneration: AI-driven platform-specific content generation with multi-source platform detection, compilation safety enforcement, and comprehensive task validation. Platform detection uses spec data, plan data, technology stack, user stories, and API endpoints for accurate platform identification with confidence scoring.
implementationPhases.compilationSafety: Every task includes compilation verification with platform-specific timeout protection: Web/Desktop/Backend (60s), Mobile (90s), AI (60s). All commands wrapped with timeout protection and error handling. Compilation safety validation ensures 0 errors before task completion.
implementationPhases.taskValidation: Comprehensive task validation with 100-point scoring system. Validates required fields, platform-specific content, compilation safety, and dependencies. Error penalties: -20 points per error, -5 points per warning. Tasks must achieve 85+ points for approval.

phase1.title: Phase 1: Project Setup & Foundations (9 tasks: TASK-001 to TASK-009)
phase1.pattern: Foundation & Design → Models & Test Suite → Core System → Architecture Refactor → Quality Refactor → Compilation → Test Execution → Integration Testing → Final Verification
phase1.instruction: 🚨 CRITICAL: Task numbering starts at TASK-001 for this phase. Essential foundation work with atomic verification: Foundation and design setup, models and comprehensive testing, core system implementation, architectural refactoring, quality improvements, compilation verification, test execution, system integration testing, and final verification. Each task requires proof: structure operational, environment configured, API contracts validated, database schema defined, models implemented, tests comprehensive, core functionality working, architecture improved, code quality enhanced, compilation successful, tests passing, integration verified, system ready for Phase 2. Number tasks as TASK-001, TASK-002, ..., TASK-009 (starting from 001, not continuing from previous phases).

phase2.title: Phase 2: Core Implementation (8 tasks: TASK-001 to TASK-008)
phase2.pattern: Business Logic → Service Layer → Controller Layer → Integration Tests → Authentication → Data Validation → Performance Optimization → Phase 2 Verification
phase2.instruction: 🚨 CRITICAL: Task numbering RESETS to TASK-001 for this phase (do NOT continue from Phase 1's TASK-009). Core business logic, service layer, controllers, authentication, and security with RED-GREEN-REFACTOR-SMOKE pattern per component. Business Logic, Service Layer, and Controller Layer each follow strict RED (tests fail) → GREEN (tests pass with ≥85% coverage) → REFACTOR (architectural review, boundaries, quality) cycle. Authentication and security implemented with comprehensive testing. Performance optimization without behavior changes. Final SMOKE test demonstrates all systems operational and secure. Number tasks as TASK-001, TASK-002, ..., TASK-008 (starting from 001 again).

phase3.title: Phase 3: UI Development (9 tasks: TASK-001 to TASK-009)
phase3.pattern: Platform Setup → Design System → Application Structure → UI Components → API Integration → State Management → User Experience → Responsive Design → Phase 3 Verification
phase3.instruction: 🚨 CRITICAL: Task numbering RESETS to TASK-001 for this phase (do NOT continue from Phase 2's TASK-008). UI components with REAL API integration (NO MOCKS ALLOWED). Platform setup and build configuration, design system with RED-GREEN-REFACTOR, application structure with routing, UI components with testing cycle, API service layer with real HTTP calls, state management implementation, user experience enhancements, responsive design and accessibility, final verification. Each component follows RED-GREEN-REFACTOR cycle with architectural review. Proof required: build success, real HTTP calls, network requests/responses, state flow verification, responsive testing, accessibility compliance. Number tasks as TASK-001, TASK-002, ..., TASK-009 (starting from 001 again).

phase4.title: Phase 4: Testing, Documentation & Deployment (7 tasks: TASK-001 to TASK-007)
phase4.pattern: Comprehensive Testing → System Optimization → Production Build → Documentation → Security Assessment → Load Testing → Database Migration
phase4.instruction: 🚨 CRITICAL: Task numbering RESETS to TASK-001 for this phase (do NOT continue from Phase 3's TASK-009). Complete testing, optimization, documentation, and production readiness with comprehensive verification. Comprehensive testing suite execution, system optimization and security hardening, production build verification, documentation generation, security assessment with penetration testing, load testing and scalability verification, database migration scripts and data seeding. Each domain follows strict verification requirements with architectural compliance. NO SHORTCUTS - every verification must be demonstrated with complete proof trail and production readiness confirmation. Number tasks as TASK-001, TASK-002, ..., TASK-007 (starting from 001 again).

databaseStrategy.title: Database Strategy
databaseStrategy.description: Comprehensive database design and implementation planning

databaseChoice.title: Database Technology Choice
databaseChoice.instruction: AI must choose appropriate production-ready database based on project requirements. Use SAME database for both development and production. 🚨 CRITICAL: SQLite is FORBIDDEN for any project. Choose from: PostgreSQL (preferred for relational/ACID), MongoDB (for documents), MySQL (for web apps), Redis (for caching). Justify choice based on project needs.

schemaDesign.title: Schema Design Planning
schemaDesign.instruction: Design enterprise-grade schema: tables/collections, relationships, indexes, constraints, data types, normalization level.

migrationStrategy.title: Migration Strategy
migrationStrategy.instruction: Plan database migrations: version control, rollback strategy, data migration, schema evolution, environment management.

connectionManagement.title: Connection Management
connectionManagement.instruction: Plan connection management: connection pooling, timeout handling, retry logic, failover, monitoring, resource cleanup.

designSystemPlanning.title: Design System Planning
designSystemPlanning.description: Comprehensive design system planning with modern UI requirements

designSystemArchitecture.title: Design System Architecture Planning
designSystemArchitecture.instruction: Plan comprehensive design system for: {{FEATURE_NAME}}. **DESIGN SYSTEM PLANNING REQUIREMENTS**: **MODERN UI MANDATE**: Design MUST be modern, sophisticated, and visually appealing (NO basic/plain designs), **DESIGN SYSTEM ARCHITECTURE**: Plan component library, design tokens, and style guide, **VISUAL HIERARCHY**: Define typography scales, spacing systems, and color palettes, **INTERACTION DESIGN**: Plan animations, transitions, and micro-interactions, **RESPONSIVE STRATEGY**: Design mobile-first responsive layouts, **ACCESSIBILITY STANDARDS**: Plan WCAG compliance and inclusive design, **BRAND CONSISTENCY**: Define visual identity and brand guidelines, **ANTI-SIMPLE-DESIGN RULE**: Explicitly prohibit basic, minimal, or plain designs. **FORBIDDEN DESIGN PATTERNS**: Basic white backgrounds with simple text, Plain buttons without styling, Minimal layouts without visual hierarchy, Simple forms without proper styling, Basic navigation without modern patterns. **REQUIRED DESIGN PATTERNS**: Modern card-based layouts with shadows and gradients, Sophisticated color schemes with proper contrast, Professional typography with proper hierarchy, Interactive elements with hover states and animations, Responsive grid systems with proper spacing, Modern form designs with proper validation styling, Professional navigation with modern patterns

modernUIPatterns.title: Modern UI Patterns Planning
modernUIPatterns.instruction: Plan modern UI patterns implementation: card-based layouts, sophisticated color schemes, professional typography, interactive elements, responsive design, modern forms, professional navigation patterns

visualEnhancementPlanning.title: Visual Enhancement Planning
visualEnhancementPlanning.instruction: Plan visual enhancements: micro-interactions, animations, visual depth with shadows and layering, smooth transitions, loading states, error state styling

apiFirstPlanning.title: API-First Planning (Web/Mobile/Backend)
apiFirstPlanning.description: Comprehensive API design and implementation planning

apiDesign.title: API Design Planning
apiDesign.instruction: Plan RESTful/GraphQL API design: endpoint structure, resource modeling, HTTP methods, status codes, API consistency.

apiContracts.title: API Contract Planning
apiContracts.instruction: Plan API contracts: request/response schemas, validation rules, error handling, data types, contract completeness.

apiTesting.title: API Testing Planning
apiTesting.instruction: Plan API testing: contract testing, integration testing, performance testing, security testing, test automation.

visualTesting.title: Visual Regression Testing Planning
visualTesting.instruction: Plan visual regression testing: Playwright setup, baseline screenshot capture, cross-browser testing, responsive design validation, visual consistency checks, CI/CD integration.

projectStructurePlanning.title: Project Structure Planning
projectStructurePlanning.instruction: Plan project structure validation and cleanup: empty folder detection, legacy code removal, technology stack consistency, architecture pattern enforcement, final structure validation.

apiDocumentation.title: API Documentation Planning
apiDocumentation.instruction: Plan API documentation: OpenAPI specification, versioning strategy, migration approach, developer experience.

platformSpecificPlanning.title: AI-Driven Platform-Specific Planning
platformSpecificPlanning.description: AI-driven platform detection and platform-specific implementation considerations with compilation safety

platformDetection.title: Platform Detection Strategy
platformDetection.instruction: Multi-source platform detection using: specification data, plan data, technology stack, user stories, API endpoints. Confidence scoring (0-100%) with fallback mechanisms. Detected platforms: web, mobile, desktop, backend, ai with framework and language identification.

compilationSafety.title: Compilation Safety Strategy
compilationSafety.instruction: Platform-specific timeout protection: Web/Desktop/Backend (60s), Mobile (90s), AI (60s). Command wrapping with error handling. Compilation verification for all tasks. Safety validation with scoring system.

web.title: Web Platform Planning (AI-Generated)
web.instruction: AI-generated web-specific considerations: React/Vue/Angular framework detection, TypeScript/JavaScript language support, responsive design, browser compatibility, performance optimization, SEO, accessibility, progressive web app features. Compilation commands: npm run build, npx tsc --noEmit with timeout protection.

mobile.title: Mobile Platform Planning (AI-Generated)
mobile.instruction: AI-generated mobile-specific considerations: React Native/Flutter framework detection, TypeScript/Dart language support, native performance, platform guidelines, app store requirements, offline capabilities, push notifications. Compilation commands: npx react-native bundle with 90s timeout protection.

desktop.title: Desktop Platform Planning (AI-Generated)
desktop.instruction: AI-generated desktop-specific considerations: Electron/Tauri framework detection, TypeScript/Rust language support, native OS integration, performance optimization, system resources, auto-updater. Compilation commands: npx electron-builder with 60s timeout protection.

backend.title: Backend Platform Planning (AI-Generated)
backend.instruction: AI-generated backend-specific considerations: Express/FastAPI framework detection, TypeScript/Python language support, scalability, security, monitoring, API design, database optimization. Compilation commands: npm run build, npm run test with 60s timeout protection.

ai.title: AI Platform Planning (AI-Generated)
ai.instruction: AI-generated AI-specific considerations: TensorFlow/PyTorch framework detection, Python/TypeScript language support, model training, inference optimization, API rate limiting, content moderation. Compilation commands: python -m pytest, python -m mypy with 60s timeout protection.

sddVersion.description: AI-driven implementation plan template with enhanced task clarity, platform detection, compilation safety, and comprehensive validation. Features specific technology commands, concrete verification requirements, and senior developer-level precision. Atomic task structure with enhanced compilation safety and validation.
